title: Ceramics School Artist Residency
source_quote: The side yard has a vegetable garden in warm months, a fire pit and a wood kiln.
evidence_sentence: The residency page mentions a wood kiln in the side yard accessible to resident artists.
evidence_quote: The side yard has a vegetable garden in warm months, a fire pit and a wood kiln.
summary: Residency offering wood kiln access plus 24-hour studio access; 4- to 10-week windows; $150–$300/week or up to $150/week with work exchange.
cost_text: $300 a week without work exchange; $150 a week with 7.5 hours/week work exchange; $300 scholarship available
pay_text: $300 per week or $150 per week with work exchange (up to 7.5 hours at $20/hour)
how_to_join: Apply by February 8 deadline for upcoming seasons (Spring May 3–30, Summer June 21–July 31, Fall Sept 20–Nov 28)
